rows.text: A false projection produced by compromised codes, forged in reference to the God-Devourer Offspring. A monstrous legion born from Asat Pramad's splitting of the power of the Voracity — the prototype of what would become the imagenae. From Ahatopia's slumbering core, he sensed the Voracity's relentless, insatiable hunger, its power pulsing in perfect harmony with the Path of Destruction. Intrigued by this restless force, he began his own dark creation — erasing human heads, leaving only grinning, devouring maws that roar, demand, and consume endlessly, never satisfied.
